strongest_angle: Forensic breakthrough: Bones found and excavated at Chew Avenue home linked to missing women case

key_facts.fact: A medical examiner was called to the Chew Avenue home in Philadelphia's Olney neighborhood to examine bones found in the yard.
Bones were recovered from the Chew Avenue home, which is at the center of an investigation involving several missing women.
Human DNA was found at the Olney 'house of horrors' in Philadelphia after investigators used luminol to search the home.

quotes.text: A medical examiner was at the Chew Avenue home that's under investigation looking at bones that were found in the yard, source says.
quotes.speaker: Emily Rose Grassi, David Charns

quotes.text: Bones have been recovered from a Philadelphia home at the center of an investigation involving several missing women, Action News has learned.
quotes.speaker: Caroline Goggin, Sharrie Williams

quotes.text: Human DNA was found at the Olney 'house of horrors' in Philadelphia after investigators sprayed luminol to search the home on West Chew Avenue, police sources said.
